hero.html:
Level 2 - Beginner30 min

Factory Method

A base class runs a fixed workflow that needs "some object", and leaves one hook - the factory method - for subclasses to decide which concrete object that is. Add a new kind by adding a subclass, never by editing the workflow.

Factory questions came up in rounds at Amazon Uber Booking Swiggy Ola PhonePe (LeetCode Discuss reports, 2026 scan).
